q: Can an EU importer deduct a Bahraini carbon price from CBAM?
title: Bahrain: any carbon price to deduct?
short: Not today. CBAM lets an importer deduct a carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin, but Bahrain has no carbon tax or emissions trading scheme in force. The full CBAM charge applies, so a lower measured emission figure is the only lever.
audience: EU importers of Bahraini aluminium and the exporters who supply them

ul: A carbon price actually paid on the embedded emissions.
Proof from the producer, with any free allocation or rebate subtracted.
A verified actual figure below the EU default.
Lower anode effect frequency, which cuts perfluorocarbons.
Clear product level data, so the right figure is used.

p: If a carbon price is introduced later, ask for payment records per tonne from the start.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
